info.title: repolore
info.description: RepoLore: local, offline operational memory for developers and coding agents, stored as Markdown. Installs the repolore command.

Read selected durable and session notes.
[--node <path>]... [--budget-tokens <n>] [--strict] [--include-method]

commands.description: Report structural findings; observes only, never fixes.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create the missing knowledge base and first checkpoint.

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Migrate alpha knowledge to v1 (check, preview, or apply).

commands.name: path
commands.description: List durable notes for a source path with status.

commands.name: restore
commands.description: Preview or restore a checkpoint within coverage.
